notes: Implemented Section 2 of Phase 3 test plan: TitleRenderer unit tests. Created MyComponents/TitleRendererTest.html with 18 tests (52 assertions) covering: (1) Basic rendering & formatting — single runs (plain, bold, italic), mixed runs, underline rendering, empty title, spaces-only title. (2) Alignment & positioning — left (margin=40), center ((width-totalWidth)/2), right (width-margin-totalWidth), empty title handling, long title centering. (3) Background rect — enabled draws background around text bounds, disabled no background, padding expansion (2*12px), single character bounds. Used Proxy-based mock context to intercept Canvas 2D API calls. All tests pass successfully.
